full_judgment: 17. I have heard the learned Advocate for both the sides and perused the materials on record. On perusal of the seizure list, it appears that Md. Saiful Islam, Md. Saidur Rahman and Md. Zillur Rahman put their signature on the same as witnesses. All those 3 seizure list witnesses have been withheld by the prosecution. It is admitted by P.W-2 Md. Solaiman All that during the course of apprehension 8/10 persons were assembled in the place of occurrence. It is curious enough that the prosecution withheld the investigating officer also. Non-examination of those relevant witnesses particularly some of the neighbour raises a presumption against the prosecution to the effect that had they been examined in this case, they would not have supported the prosecution case and benefit of such defect will go to the credit of the defence. It is an acceptable proposition that if the witness of search and seizure are making obliging statements in favour of the accused to save him from punishment, the court may convict the accused persons solely on the basis of the unimpeachable evidence of the officer who made the search and seizure. In the instant case, the prosecution has withheld the witnesses of search and seizure. However, let me proceed to see the evidences of the police and see there form as to how far their evidences are said to unimpeachable in nature.
